title: py_ntcpx v1.1.1 — NTCP analysis and machine learning pipeline for radiotherapy dose–volume data

creators.name: Mondal, K.
creators.affiliation: North Bengal Medical College, Darjeeling, India

description:
py_ntcpx v1.1.1 is a correctness release. It corrects twelve defects found while re-executing the published v1.1.0 pipeline from the raw dose–volume histograms and reconciling every published value against that run. No study design, model, hyperparameter or dataset was changed.

py_ntcpx computes normal tissue complication probability (NTCP) from cumulative dose–volume histograms using classical radiobiological models (Lyman–Kutcher–Burman probit and log-logistic, relative-seriality Poisson, gEUD) alongside a four-tier machine-learning evaluation, with calibration, overfitting grading and SHAP/LIME explainability.

What changed in 1.1.1

  • Reproducibility: the Monte Carlo samplers, SHAP bootstrap resampling and LIME were unseeded; all are now seeded and repeat runs are bit-identical.
  • Evaluation correctness: Tier-4 apparent AUC was computed from the first cross-validation fold's model applied to every patient; each model is now refit on the full cohort. Tier-3 standardisation is now fitted inside each fold. Summary metrics are now read at full precision rather than from a four-decimal workbook.
  • Reporting honesty: clinical-suitability language derived from an overfitted model's apparent AUC has been removed.
  • Cohort Consistency Score: a single documented column is emitted, with ccs_specification.json recording the metrics, covariance treatment and the adaptive nature of the 0.10 threshold.
  • Overfitting grading: one documented four-level scheme now produces every grade.

Full details are in CHANGELOG.md and the release notes for tag py_ntcpx_v1.1.1.

Data

The accompanying archive is keyed on anonymised identifiers PT001–PT054 only. No patient name, hospital identifier or exporting user appears anywhere in the deposit. The identifier mapping is the re-identification key and is deliberately not deposited.
